Drop table dw.DimCustomerNameURL_CBS_UT;

select 
    concat(dc.customername, ' - ',dc.customerid) as NameID,
    dc.customerid as CustomerID,
    case when dc.customertype in('Retail','RETAIL') then concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/054d1bb6-a09f-4344-a726-def4f7d63266/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''') 
            ELSE  concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/f32789be-9d16-4410-adf5-a248a52e3737/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''')
     END as URL
into dw.DimCustomerNameURL_CBS_UT
from dw.dimcustomernametest dc
where dc.customerid in (select distinct customerid from dw.dimcustomeraccount
                    where sourcesystemcode = 'DEP'
                    and banksk = 2)
